author: everestmcarthur
install_msg:
Thanks for installing **VoiceMeister v1.0.0** — the ultimate temporary voice channel system!

**Quick Start:**
• `[p]voicemeister setup` — Interactive setup wizard
• `[p]voicemeister creator add #channel` — Add a Join-to-Create channel
• `[p]voicemeister panel #channel` — Send the control panel
• `[p]vc` — User voice channel commands

**Panel Controls:** Lock, Unlock, Hide, Unhide, Rename, User Limit, Kick, Ban, Permit, Reject, Claim, Transfer, Bitrate, Info, Ghost (hide + lock), and Delete.

**Name Templates:** `{user}`, `{game}`, `{count}`, `{custom}`

Full help: `[p]help VoiceMeister`
name: VoiceMeister
short: Ultimate temporary voice channels: Join-to-Create, full control panel with buttons, name templates, game detection, logging & more.
description: VoiceMeister v1.0.0 is a comprehensive temporary voice channel management system. Features: Join-to-Create channels that auto-spawn personal voice channels, a persistent button control panel (Lock/Unlock, Hide/Unhide, Rename, User Limit, Kick, Ban, Permit, Reject, Claim, Transfer, Bitrate, Info, Ghost, Delete), name templates with {user}/{game}/{count}/{custom} variables, automatic game-activity channel renaming, auto-cleanup when channels empty, logging to a dedicated channel, blacklist/whitelist system, per-user channel limits, cooldowns, default settings per creator, category management, and full slash-compatible hybrid commands. All views are persistent and survive bot restarts.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, guild IDs, and channel IDs for voice channel ownership and settings. Per-user data includes channel ownership, ban/permit lists, and usage cooldowns. Data is cleaned up when channels are deleted.
